description: The plot illustrates the relationship between recent sequence ratio and perplexity, as well as recent sequence ratio and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Perplexity” and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A solid orange line with circular markers represents perplexity, starting at approximately 4.62 at a recent sequence ratio of 0%, decreasing to approximately 4.32 at a recent sequence ratio of 40%, then increasing to approximately 4.38 at a recent sequence ratio of 100%. A dashed red line represents a constant value of approximately 4.38 across the entire x-axis range. A solid blue line with circular markers represents GPU memory ratio, starting at approximately 42% at a recent sequence ratio of 0%, increasing to approximately 45% at a recent sequence ratio of 40%, then increasing sharply to approximately 100% at a recent sequence ratio of 100%. A dashed blue line represents a constant value of approximately 60% across the entire x-axis range.
